documents.title: Noting In The Board Meeting Dated 29.10.2026 Delay In Submission Of Shareholding Pattern Under Reg 31(1)(B) To NSE.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Management reported a strong operational and financial performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, highlighted by significant growth in consolidated total income, EBITDA, PBT, and PAT compared to the previous year. The company expects to maintain a growth rate of over 30% for FY27 and FY28, driven by domestic demand, rapidly growing US exports, and newly established business pipelines in Europe. Management continues to focus on cost absorption, process improvements, and automation (including robotic cells and AI visual inspection) to combat rising raw material and employee costs while sustaining robust EBITDA margins between 20% and 22%. Menon Bearings Limited presented its Q2 & H1FY27 investor presentation, highlighting a 58.6% YoY growth in Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue from operations to Rs 100.88 crore. The company is implementing robotic automation and expanding production capacities across its Bi-Metals, Alkop, and Braking Systems divisions with planned capex over the next two years.

guidance.claim: Management expects more than 30% growth for the financial year FY27.
guidance.quote: There will be more than 30% growth for this year, FY27, and similarly in '27-'28 also we expect, if all the things are in place, it will be more than 30% again, with the growth drivers are basically domestic and whatever export that USA exports are growing rapidly.

guidance.claim: For FY27, estimated additional business expected is around INR 30 crores on a consolidated basis.
guidance.quote: And what I feel, that considering the current business pipeline and the commercial discussions and RFQs that we have received, for '26-'27, additional business expected is around INR 30 crores on consolidated basis.

guidance.claim: For '27-'28, estimated additional business will be of INR 131 crores.
guidance.quote: And for '27-'28, we expect that estimated additional business will be of INR 131 crores, so that, the growth rate will be obviously more than 30%, with '28-'29, the growth driver, we are having the list of all customers also from whom we are estimated to get the business, RFQs are there, and discussions are going on, commercials have been finalized.

guidance.claim: For 2029, management expects additional business of INR 157 crores excluding potential business of INR 35 crores of Europe.
guidance.quote: And with this, for 2029, we expect additional business of INR 157 crores, excluding potential business of INR 35 crores of Europe that we estimate it will take little more time, but 100% we are going to convert that.

guidance.claim: Management targets EBITDA margins of about 23% for next year.
guidance.quote: And what we are targeting for next year, the EBITDA margins will be about 23%.

guidance.claim: The company expects the total potential of additional business for the current and next financial year to be around INR65 crores to INR75 crores.
guidance.quote: The total potential of additional business for the current and next financial year is expected to be around INR65 crores to INR75 crores, subject to good monsoon and geopolitical situation doesn't worsen further.

guidance.claim: Management targets Alkop revenue of INR100 crores for the year and around INR125 crores for next year.
guidance.quote: For this year, we are targeting Alkop for INR100 crores, next year around INR125 crores.

guidance.claim: The company targets the share of EV in the Alkop business to be in the range of 8% to 10% by the end of FY27.
guidance.quote: share of EV by FY27 end can be in the range of 8% to 10%.

guidance.claim: Management estimates that export may go up to 37% of total revenue by next year.
guidance.quote: As we expect that by next year, the export may go up to 37% after total revenue.

demand_outlook.claim: Management states that US exports are growing rapidly.
demand_outlook.quote: There will be more than 30% growth for this year, FY27, and similarly in '27-'28 also we expect, if all the things are in place, it will be more than 30% again, with the growth drivers are basically domestic and whatever export that USA exports are growing rapidly.

demand_outlook.claim: Management notes that OEM business grew by almost 50% and exports grew by more than 75% compared to the same quarter last year.
demand_outlook.quote: We can see there is a growth as compared to the same quarter last year. There is a growth in OEM's business by almost 50%, and similarly there is a growth in export more than 75%.

demand_outlook.claim: European companies are exploring India as a supply base under China Plus One and Europe Plus One policies, resulting in numerous RFQs.
demand_outlook.quote: Now new customers also, like new customers which we are not supplying to, they are also coming to India, like exploring India as their supply base for the next 4 years, 10 years.

capex_expansion.claim: Investment plans for the next 12 to 15 months include roughly INR 5 crores in Menon Alkop and around INR 4 crores in bearings.
capex_expansion.quote: So what figures we have told you, what we are going to achieve. So this is the investment we are doing to increase productivity and to get these numbers. So this is the investment we are getting, and roughly ROI will be in the next 2.5, 3 years, should be the return on investment on this investment what we are doing.

capex_expansion.claim: Management states that CapEx is being funded entirely out of internal accruals.
capex_expansion.quote: Whatever CapEx that we are doing, that is out of internal accruals, which are definitely having the impact on the cash accruals.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is investing about INR9 crores to INR10 crores this financial year for increasing bi-metal capacity by 25% to 30%.
capex_expansion.quote: we are investing about INR9 crores to INR10 crores of rupees for this year, this financial year for increasing the capacity and which is expected to increase the capacity by almost 25% to 30%, which may yield the total revenue of more than INR25 crores, which can generate revenue of INR25 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is incurring a CapEx of around INR4 crores for this year in Alkop alone.
capex_expansion.quote: And we are having the CapEx of around INR4 crores of for this year in Alkop alone.

margins_costs.claim: Process improvements and reduced raw material consumption helped sustain margins despite price volatility in copper, tin, lead, and steel.
margins_costs.quote: In spite of volatility in the raw material prices, and basically in copper, tin, lead and steel, the prices have gone up substantially. In spite of that whatever the exercises that we have made, improvement in the processes, so we have reduced substantially so far as the consumption of all these raw material and input material is concerned.

margins_costs.claim: Volume growth and a 25% increase in productivity helped reduce and absorb overhead costs.
margins_costs.quote: Apart from that, you can see there is a volume growth and productivity has substantially increased, that is by 25% over last period. That has really helped us in reducing the overheads overall.

margins_costs.claim: Segment margins are stated as 30% to 35% for Brakes, 18% to 19% for Alkop, and 23% for Bearings.
margins_costs.quote: Okay, so far as Brakes is concerned, the margins are 30% to 35%. It depends upon the mix of the product, but it is between 30% to 35%, okay, that is one thing. In Alkop, it is 18% to 19%, whereas in Bearing, it is 23%, okay?

margins_costs.claim: The company reported a consolidated EBITDA margin of 22.00% for Q2 FY27.
Management noted that the EBITDA margin in the brakes segment reached 25%.
margins_costs.quote: But at the same time, I would like to tell you that right from 12% EBITDA earlier, now we have reached to 25% EBITDA in brakes also.

margins_costs.claim: Carbide tool prices for all automobile manufacturers have increased by 300%.
margins_costs.quote: Consumables, for example, carbide tools for all manufacturers, all automobile carbide tools are required.Those carbide tools price are increased by 300%.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated margins are expected to be sustained around 20% to 21% over a period of time.
margins_costs.quote: overall, on a consolidated basis, if you see, we will sustainaround 20% to 21% of margins over a period of time.

orders_capacity.claim: For Menon Alkop, around 54 parts have been developed in the last two years and start of business (SOB) has begun.
orders_capacity.quote: For Menon Alkop, we have developed around 54 parts in the last two years, and they all SOB has begun. So that's why you can see the growth. So a lot of new high value addition products have been added to the portfolio.

orders_capacity.claim: Peak revenue from the bi-metal division can be above INR400 crores without land expansion.
orders_capacity.quote: Peak revenue from this, it can be aboveINR400 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The company avails packing credit limits from bankers at lower rates of 4.65% to 4.75% supported by government subvention.
capital_allocation.quote: Apart from that, we are availing packing credit limit from bankers, which is now available at the rate of 4.65%, 4.75% only. So the debtors will increase, but at the same time, our working capital requirements are being fulfilled through this so that we get a loan at -- working capital loan at a very lower rate considering the subvention given by the government as well of 2.75%.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management notes potential risks from volatility in commodity prices like copper, tin, lead, and steel, as well as geopolitical conditions.
risks_headwinds.quote: In spite of volatility in the raw material prices, and basically in copper, tin, lead and steel, the prices have gone up substantially.

management_commitments.claim: The dynamometer for the brake segment is expected to be commissioned by the end of August.
management_commitments.quote: You see, basically that is under construction now and is expected by the end of August.

management_commitments.claim: Menon Brakes expects an initial business of around INR5 crores to INR6 crores in the first year after railway approval, and eventually INR25 crores to INR30 crores within the next two years.
management_commitments.quote: we expect that to start with, we will have a business of around INR5 crores to INR6 crores to start with and eventually it will go up to INR25 crores to INR30 crores within next two years.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
